III. Read the passage and answer the questions below

Hi, my name is Phong. Tet is coming, and my family is preparing many things. Today is Saturday, so we are not at school. Right now, we are cleaning our house. My father is cleaning the furniture and my mother is cooking special food. I am helping my parents by sweeping the floor. My sister, Mi, is hanging a new calendar on the wall. This afternoon, we will go to the market to buy some peach blossoms and red envelopes. We won't buy fireworks because they are dangerous. During Tet, we will wear our new clothes and visit our relatives. We should behave well and make wishes for everyone. I love Tet because it is a special time for us to gather together.

QUICK RECAP / MINI REVIEW (ÔN TẬP NHANH BÀI HỌC)

Từ vựng trọng tâm:

  • peach blossom: hoa đào 🔊
  • apricot blossom: hoa mai 🔊
  • lucky money: tiền lì xì 🔊
  • family gathering: đoàn tụ gia đình 🔊

Ngữ pháp ghi nhớ:

  • Will + V-bare: Quyết định bộc phát / lời hứa.
  • Should / Shouldn't + V-bare: Lời khuyên nên / không nên làm.
  • Present continuous: Hành động đang diễn ra hiện tại.
